contact_name.description: Full name of the contact person

contact_email.description: Contact email address for the quote response

contact_phone.description: Optional phone number for the coordinator to reach the buyer (event ops is phone-first; include when known)

event_name.description: Name of the event (e.g. 'HIMSS 2026', 'Brand Fest Austin')

event_type.description: Event type: trade-show, conference, festival, concert, sporting-event, corporate, brand-activation, or other

city.description: City where the event is held

event_dates.description: Event dates as a human-readable string, e.g. 'June 15–17, 2026'

role.description: Staffing role name, e.g. brand-ambassadors, registration-staff

roles.description: Roles and headcount needed for the event

budget_range.description: Estimated total budget range if calculated, e.g. '$8,400–$12,600'

special_requirements.description: Any special requirements: language skills, certifications, overnight shifts, etc.

compliance_notes.description: Any compliance flags surfaced by get_compliance_by_state

source_platform.description: Optional agent/platform attribution, e.g. chatgpt-gpt, claude-desktop, coze

skill_version.description: Optional version of the TempGuru staffing skill used to assemble this request

skill_id.description: Optional canonical TempGuru skill slug that assembled this request

plan_id.description: Optional plan_id returned by plan_staffing; links the submitted quote to its saved non-PII plan
